text:
tara: quick thread — we need to agree on the observability v1 landing for the console. two competing asks: exportable billing accuracy vs fast SRE triage (dashboards + traces). want a single decision and clear launch criteria by EOD.

ev an: billing asks want invoice-ready numbers. that pushes heavy aggregation and allocation heuristics. SREs care more about immediate triage: per-route cost, error slices, and trace links.

li: tech reality: exact tenant billing requires expensive nightly reconciliation because of shared GPU work and cache reuse. safer: route-first dashboards + estimated tenant exports marked "ESTIMATE".

mike: propose hybrid-lite: ship route-first dashboards + CSV export with allocation method + uncertainty column. include trace-lite: very low global sampling + 100% on errors and a quick trace-id link in the dashboard.

sophie: sampling suggestion: global 0.1% baseline, error=100% on error events, ability to flip sampling per-tenant. acceptance: trace sampling must not push p95 > +4% in canary.

tara: Launch criteria proposal: 
- per-route cost table (top 30) visible in UI and exportable to CSV
- per-tenant CSV export with `allocation_method` and `uncertainty_pct` columns
- error analytics: slice by model/version/route with delta vs baseline
- trace-lite: global_sampling <=0.001 and error_sampling=1.0; dashboard shows trace_id when available
- perf: canary p95 impact <4% and infra cost delta <=12% for beta cohort
- ops: runtime toggle to disable tracing per-tenant within 15 minutes

ev an: rollout plan: internal canary at 5% for 10 days, monitor allocation error vs synthetic ground-truth, then expand to 25% for 14 days before GA. need sales comms for tenant CSVs.

li: engineering asks: 2 backend (aggregation + allocation), 1 infra for benching and canary automation, 1 frontend for templates and CSV UI. estimate 3 sprints to canary. also want a small eval harness to measure allocation accuracy.

mike: infra-bench note: staging with 0.1% global sampling at 50k rps -> ~20GB/day traces and p95 +1.8%. switching to 0.05% yields ~10GB/day and p95 +1.0%.

sophie: UI note: show an "estimated" badge prominently and an explain modal that shows how allocation was computed. this reduces finance support tickets.

tara: ok will lock plan: route-first dashboards + estimated per-tenant exports + trace-lite as above. i'll add the acceptance checklist to the roadmap item and file the PRD. if anyone objects speak now, otherwise i'll tag this locked by EOD. :lock:
